احتظروا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَظَرُوا (iḥtaẓarū) /iħ.ta.ðˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَظَرَ (iḥtaẓara)
# اِحْتَظِرُوا (iḥtaẓirū) /iħ.ta.ðˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَظَرَ (iḥtaẓara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
